achievements.name: Rippling Walls
achievements.detail: Cross the opening stretch as the shattered streets knit themselves back together under the Kid.

achievements.name: Monument Core
achievements.detail: Set a Core into the Monument and use it to raise one of the Bastion's buildings.

achievements.name: Arsenal Loadout
achievements.detail: Raise the Arsenal and head out with a weapon chosen from its rack.

achievements.name: Distillery Spirit
achievements.detail: Equip a Spirit at the Distillery before leaving on the next trip.

achievements.name: Forge Upgrade
achievements.detail: Spend a material and Fragments at the Forge to add an upgrade to a weapon.

achievements.name: Shrine Idol
achievements.detail: Activate an Idol at the Shrine so enemies hit harder and grant more Fragments and experience.

achievements.name: Proving Grounds
achievements.detail: Take the top prize in a weapon's Proving Grounds challenge.

achievements.name: Who Knows Where
achievements.detail: Clear every wave of a Who Knows Where dream opened by a recovered memento.

achievements.name: Memorial Vigil
achievements.detail: Finish a Vigil listed at the Memorial and collect the Fragments it pays.

achievements.name: Skyway Trip
achievements.detail: Ride the Skyway out from the Bastion and finish the district at its far end.

achievements.name: Story's End
achievements.detail: Finish the journey and choose the ending that closes this story.

achievements.name: New Game Plus
achievements.detail: Clear the story again in New Game Plus with the Kid's levels, weapons, and upgrades still in hand.
